parents.notes: Artabazus is explicitly named as her father; her mother is not identified in this passage.

relations.notes: Marriage at Susa; continuation or dissolution after Alexander’s death is not established.

variants.description: Plutarch names Ptolemy’s bride Apama where Arrian names Artacama. Bennett considers this a confusion with Seleucus’s wife; Shahbazi lists both names for Artabazus’s daughter. This name attestation does not identify her with Seleucus’s wife or with Artabazus’s mother.

variants.description: Bennett proposes Artabazus’s unnamed Rhodian wife as Artakama’s mother but says the maternity is not explicitly stated. Her mother’s identity remains unresolved.

sources.reference: Chris Bennett, Egyptian Royal Genealogy, Artakama, text and notes 1-5

variants.description: Bennett treats repudiation after Alexander’s death as conditional. The Susa wedding is recorded without asserting a divorce date or children.
